title: Establish Secret Base & Ominous Rumors
gameText: Deploy on Endor system. Your Force drains at X other battleground systems are +1, where X = number of Endor sites you occupy. Your Force drains here are +2 while you control at least 2 Endor battleground sites with AT-STs and/or biker scouts. Place Effect in Used Pile if opponent controls this system or three Endor sites.
evidence: Image visually inspected: portrait, no bottom credit coins or EpisodeI. Approved Hidden Weapons character singular overlay.

title: Hidden Weapons & Twi'lek Advisor
gameText: If Boba Fett, or your character with Mandalorian Armor is present during the weapons phase of a battle, target one opponent's character present. Draw Destiny: (0-1) no effect; (2-3) character immediately captured; (4-5) character is hit; (6+) character immediately lost. OR Use 3 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take one Effect of any kind into hand; reshuffle.
evidence: Image visually inspected: portrait, no bottom credit coins or EpisodeI. Approved Hidden Weapons character singular overlay.

title: I've Got A Problem Here & Physical Choke
gameText: Use 1 Force to target opponent's starfighter with maneuver at a system or sector where a battle just finished. Draw destiny. Starfighter lost if destiny > maneuver. OR If a Dark Jedi is present at a battle you have just won, use 1 Force to attempt to choke an opposing character present. Draw destiny. If destiny > target's ability, target is lost.
